apps.name: Bifrost Foundation
apps.summary: The base app every other Bifrost app needs: the standard Business Central capabilities, a REST API, queue, setup page and secret store.

apps.name: Bifrost Language Models
apps.summary: Chat with Business Central beside the record you have open, with Copilot, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, xAI or your own model.
apps.summary_is: Spjallaðu við Business Central við hlið færslunnar sem þú ert með opna, með Copilot, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, xAI eða eigin líkani.

apps.name: Bifrost Attachments
apps.summary: Connect configured Business Central file accounts to Bifrost for file operations and data exchange.
apps.summary_is: Tengdu uppsetta skráareikninga Business Central við Bifröst fyrir skráaraðgerðir og gagnaskipti.

apps.name: Bifrost Subscription Billing
apps.summary: Run recurring billing from an assistant or integration: contracts, billing runs, usage data and deferrals in Microsoft's Subscription Billing app.
apps.summary_is: Keyrðu reglulega reikningagerð úr aðstoð eða samþættingu: samninga, reikningskeyrslur, notkunargögn og frestanir í Subscription Billing appi Microsoft.
